components.json.text:
{
  "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1aGh/maude/main/apps/studio/schema/ds-components-v1.schema.json",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "system": "maude",
  "components": {
    "Button": {
      "class": "btn",
      "export": "Button",
      "specimen": "preview/components-buttons.tsx",
      "variants": { "primary": "btn--primary", "secondary": null, "ghost": "btn--ghost", "danger": "btn--danger" },
      "sizes": { "sm": "btn--sm", "lg": null },
      "fallback": { "secondary": "ghost" },
      "label": "Button"
    },
    "IconButton": {
      "class": "btn btn--icon",
      "export": "IconButton",
      "specimen": "preview/components-buttons.tsx",
      "variants": { "primary": "btn--primary", "secondary": null, "ghost": "btn--ghost", "danger": "btn--danger" },
      "sizes": { "sm": "btn--sm", "lg": null },
      "label": "Icon button"
    },
    "Input": { "class": "input", "export": "Input", "specimen": "preview/components-inputs.tsx", "sizes": { "sm": null }, "label": "Input" },
    "Field": { "class": "field", "export": "Field", "specimen": "preview/components-inputs.tsx", "label": "Field" },
    "Switch": { "class": "switch", "export": "Switch", "specimen": "preview/components-toggles.tsx", "label": "Switch" },
    "Checkbox": { "class": "checkbox", "export": "Checkbox", "specimen": "preview/components-toggles.tsx", "label": "Checkbox" },
    "Segmented": { "class": "seg", "export": "Segmented", "sizes": { "sm": null }, "label": "Segmented control" },
    "Tabs": { "class": "tabbar tab", "export": "Tabs", "label": "Tabs" },
    "Chip": {
      "class": "chip",
      "export": "Chip",
      "variants": { "accent": null, "soft": null },
      "label": "Chip"
    },
    "Badge": {
      "class": "tag",
      "export": "Badge",
      "variants": { "success": null, "warn": null, "error": null, "info": null, "accent": "tag--accent" },
      "label": "Badge (this system's tag)"
    },
    "Card": {
      "class": "panel",
      "export": "Card",
      "variants": { "raised": null, "interactive": null, "flat": null },
      "label": "Card (this system's shared panel material)"
    },
    "Callout": {
      "class": "callout",
      "export": "Callout",
      "specimen": "preview/components-callout.tsx",
      "variants": { "info": "callout--info", "success": "callout--success", "warn": "callout--warn", "error": "callout--error" },
      "label": "Callout"
    },
    "Dialog": { "class": "dialog", "export": "Dialog", "specimen": "preview/components-dialogs.tsx", "label": "Dialog" },
    "Tooltip": { "class": "tooltip", "export": "Tooltip", "specimen": "preview/components-tooltips.tsx", "label": "Tooltip" }
  },
  "typeRoles": {
    "title": "t-title",
    "heading": "t-heading",
    "subheading": "t-subheading",
    "body": "t-body",
    "body-sm": "t-body-sm",
    "caption": "t-caption",
    "label": "t-label",
    "eyebrow": "t-eyebrow",
    "code": "t-code",
    "num": "t-num"
  },
  "icons": {
    "family": "maude",
    "export": "Icon",
    "map": {
      "home": "home",
      "search": "search",
      "add": "add",
      "close": "close",
      "check": "check",
      "chevron-up": "chevron-up",
      "chevron-down": "chevron-down",
      "chevron-left": "chevron-left",
      "chevron-right": "chevron-right",
      "arrow-up": "arrow-up",
      "arrow-down": "arrow-down",
      "arrow-left": "arrow-left",
      "arrow-right": "arrow-right",
      "more": "more",
      "settings": "settings",
      "user": "user",
      "users": "users",
      "bell": "bell",
      "share": "share",
      "link": "link",
      "trash": "trash",
      "edit": "edit",
      "copy": "copy",
      "download": "download",
      "upload": "upload",
      "lock": "lock",
      "info": "info",
      "warning": "warning",
      "error": "error",
      "success": "success",
      "star": "star",
      "heart": "heart",
      "calendar": "calendar",
      "clock": "clock",
      "image": "image",
      "file": "file",
      "folder": "folder",
      "play": "play",
      "pause": "pause",
      "external": "external"
    }
  },
  "ext": {
    "Toolbar": { "export": "ext.Toolbar", "class": "toolbar", "label": "Toolbar" },
    "InspectorRow": { "export": "ext.InspectorRow", "class": "insp-row", "label": "Inspector row" },
    "TreeRow": { "export": "ext.TreeRow", "class": "tree-row", "label": "Tree row" },
    "PresenceDot": { "export": "ext.PresenceDot", "class": "presence-dot", "label": "Presence dot" }
  }
}
